record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, shorten the causal recency-pooling decay scale from 4 to 2 while retaining readout_t=0.75*h_t+0.25*p_t. Define p_t using normalized exp(-(t-j)/2) weights over nonpadding states j<=t. This preserves the context contribution that outperformed a weaker pooling weight while concentrating it on immediate interests. Keep truncation, cumulative observed-position IDs, input features, embeddings, HSTU backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Match training and generated inference, reading the final real position.
